queries.text: "Aprofundamentos" (literally "deepenings"): a set of short notes that deepen points from the earlier books. Used "Going deeper"; alternatives: "Deeper insights", "Further explorations".
"virar o barco" (literally "turn the boat around"): to reverse the situation. Kept the image; alternative: "turn the tables".

"Estreitamento da intimidade" (literally "narrowing of intimacy"): growing closer, increasing intimacy. Heading "Narrowing the distance of intimacy"; alternatives: "Deepening intimacy", "Growing closer".

"O Alienista" → "The Alienist" (established English title of Machado de Assis’s novella). "O Imbecil Coletivo" (Olavo de Carvalho, 1996) has no established English edition; translated as "The Collective Imbecile".

Wordplay: "desgraçados" means "wretches," and the author reads it as "des-graçados," "deprived of Grace." Rendered "dis-graced wretches" to keep the pun; alternative: "We human beings are wretches (deprived of the Grace of the Spirit)" with a TN.
"sangue de barata" (literally "cockroach blood"): Brazilian idiom for imperturbable coolness. Rendered "ice water in our veins"; alternative: "a cool head".
